description: Guards Bash, file, MCP, scheduler and message tool calls (hooks/guard.mjs): denies operator-session writes (OPR-01), merge messages without the review trailer (DEC-08) and destructive git/GitHub actions, and asks the owner on shared ones (under an unattended go it allows only the go's verified pinned release steps and the delete of a merged topic branch); also validates OKF docs after edits, records pushes in the session ledger and hands the operator its file at session start. A guard timeout or crash blocks the call (onFailure: block). Detail: docs/threat-model.md and README.
